## Parent / origin

Migrated from Bead `FPL-762` (was **open**, priority 2).
Discovered from `FPL-761` as the prospective replacement for missing 2025/26 history.

## Status at migration

Open. Intended to prevent the historical rank-threshold gap recurring in 2026/27
by capturing official Overall league standings at immutable post-finalisation
checkpoints.

## What

Capture official FPL Overall league (league id 314) standings at immutable
post-finalisation checkpoints for GW1–GW38, including page/rank/total points,
field-size metadata, `observed_at`, `available_at`, finalisation state, endpoint
parameters and source/artifact SHA-256.

Register the endpoint and rights/retention decision **before** automated
collection. Preserve missing pages as explicit gaps; never infer historical ranks
from current standings. Produce threshold rows the rank-calibration evaluator can
label exact or bounded. Keep collection downstream of the decision path.

## Files

- `control/sources/source-registry.yaml`
- `config/data_sources/2026-27-rank-thresholds.json`
- `src/ingestion/official_global_standings.py`
- `src/evaluation/rank_calibration.py`
- `tests/ingestion/test_official_global_standings.py`
- `docs/data-sources/rank-thresholds.md`
- `docs/runbooks/2026-27-capture-schedule.md`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Registry entry with confirmed `licence_status` and `allowed_use` before enablement.
- [ ] Collector disabled by default until approval; point-in-time fields present on every snapshot.
- [ ] Missing pages recorded as gaps (no inference from live standings).
- [ ] Threshold artifacts consumable by rank calibration as exact or bounded.
- [ ] Focused ingestion tests pass; no secrets in repo.

## Blocked by

Owner approval of the Overall-league capture rights/retention decision (related to historical source ticket).

## Non-goals

Backfilling 2025/26 from current standings; feeding ranks into the pre-deadline decision path.
